theater: 巴爾干、希臘與義大利戰線

battle.name: 亞拉里克一世的征服
battle.theater: 巴爾干、希臘與義大利戰線
battle.brief: 西元395年狄奧多西一世病逝，帝國東西分立，亞拉里克率西哥德人渡多瑙河、掠過希臘，再沿亞平寧逼近義大利，終於410年8月逼降羅馬。卡面羅馬短劍正是雙方在同一條戰線上反覆相撞的兵器：短兵相接靠的是盾緣與刺突節奏，攻城槌與弩砲之後的最後幾尺，仍然要靠它。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries:
交戰的一方是西哥德聯盟。亞拉里克於395年繼承王位後，率領的是一個以多瑙河下游為根據地的日耳曼聯盟：主力為西哥德騎兵與步兵，聯盟裡還裹著塔伊法爾人等東日耳曼部眾，以及被征服後編入的斯拉夫與匈奴戰俘。軍隊編制沿用部落慣例，分成百人隊與千人隊，各有百夫長與千夫長，另有專司傳令與談判的傳令官。戰利品、俘虜與輜重車隊跟著隊伍移動，補給主要靠就地徵收與劫掠，不像羅馬那樣有固定的軍糧線。

另一方是羅馬帝國西部，統治核心在米蘭與拉文納，皇帝荷瑞留斯只是名義上的最高統帥，真正掌握軍權的是禁衛長斯提利科。西部野戰軍由帝國直屬軍團、以協議編入的蠻族傭兵（foederati）與各地民兵組成，另有拉文納分艦隊與羅馬城內由元老與市民組成的武裝。410年8月守城戰中，羅馬方面的戰鬥核心是帝國騎兵與城內民兵，拉文納的船隊則負責把北非與西西里的糧食運進台伯河口。

第三方是羅馬帝國東部，首都君士坦丁堡，阿卡狄奧斯在位。東部握有埃及與北非的糧食與現金，握有羅馬世界大部分的財政資源，是雙方在外交上拉攏與付款能力上的真正所在。
countriesEn:
One side in this war was the Visigothic confederation. When Alaric took the kingship in 395 he led a Germanic alliance whose base lay on the lower Danube: its core was Visigothic cavalry and infantry, and within the coalition travelled Taifals and other East Germanic communities together with Slavs and Hunnic captives folded into the host after conquest. The tribal organisation survived in the field: the army was broken up into hundreds and thousands, each with its own centenarius and chiliarch, and a body of referendaries handled envoys and negotiation. Booty, slaves and the baggage train moved with the column, and supply came mainly from foraging and from whatever the countryside could yield, with none of the fixed grain routes that Rome possessed.

The other side was the Western Roman Empire, whose practical centre of gravity lay at Milan and Ravenna, with the emperor Honorius a nominal commander-in-chief and the magister militum Stilicho holding the real military power. The western field army combined regular imperial units, barbarian foederati enrolled by treaty, and local militias, backed by the Ravenna fleet and by the armed burgesses of Rome organised by the senators and city officials. In the fighting around the city in August 410 the Roman strength rested on the imperial cavalry and the militia of the capital, while the ships out of Ravenna carried grain from North Africa and Sicily up the Tiber mouth.

A third party stood apart: the Eastern Empire under Arcadius at Constantinople. It held the grain and the cash of Egypt and North Africa, and with them the greater part of the Roman world's financial resources, which made the eastern court the true source of both diplomatic leverage and payment capacity.
people:
亞拉里克一世（約370－410）是西哥德人的第一位國王，也是第一位站到羅馬城牆下的蠻族君主。395年他以「高盧軍務總監」的名義率眾進入帝國，先在塞薩利與阿提卡橫掃，396年6月焚毀雅典的雅典娜神殿；與斯提利科議和後取得「伊利里庫姆軍務總監」頭銜，401年因拒絕被派往東方平叛而再度反叛，405年攻入希臘後在南方簽下協議。此後他兩度包圍羅馬，410年8月迫使羅馬議會投降。

斯提利科（約359－408）是西部的實際統帥。395年他與亞拉里克在薩瓦河一線議定西哥德人渡河的條件，406年在維羅納擊潰拉達蓋蘇斯，408年為皇帝與西哥德人反覆交涉，最後被皇帝下令在拉文納處死。他的死等於羅馬西部失去了唯一能同時壓住軍隊與皇帝的將領，羅馬城此後再沒有一個懂得如何對付西哥德人的人。

皇帝荷瑞留斯395年即位，402年起以拉文納為實際首都，410年八月時他仍在拉文納，羅馬陷落並沒有直接威脅他的性命。408年他拒絕支付亞拉里克索取的巨額金錢並禁止異教，隨即在奧利匹烏斯操縱下清洗斯提利科。兄長阿塔烏夫在亞拉里克死後接掌部眾，率軍西行，415年進入高盧，416年越過比利牛斯山入西班牙。羅馬方面的將領有米爾維恩橋與波爾塔波爾泰塞兩役的騎兵統帥阿洛鮑德與巴西，以及410年代表羅馬議會投降的城務官普羅比努斯；教父耶柔米與奧羅修斯的記述，是今日判斷410年之事的兩份主要文獻。
peopleEn:
Alaric I (c. 370-410) was the first king of the Visigoths and the first barbarian ruler to stand beneath the walls of Rome. In 395 he entered the empire as magister militum per Gallias, sweeping through Thessaly and Attica and burning the temple of Athena at Athens in June 396. After his settlement with Stilicho he took the title of magister militum per Illyricum; in 401 he rebelled again by refusing to be sent east to suppress the usurper, and in 405 he campaigned through Greece and signed a treaty in the south after his advance. He then twice besieged Rome and in August 410 forced the Roman senate to surrender.

Stilicho (c. 359-408) was the actual commander of the west. In 395 he met Alaric on the line of the Sava and agreed the terms on which the Visigoths would cross the Danube; in 406 he broke Radagaisus at Verona; in 408 he negotiated endlessly between the emperor and the Visigoths, and was finally executed at Ravenna on the emperor's orders. His death removed the only man in the western empire who could hold both the army and the emperor in check, and Rome was left with nobody who understood how to deal with the Visigoths.

The emperor Honorius took the throne in 395 and made Ravenna his real capital from 402; in August 410 he was still in Ravenna, and the fall of Rome did not directly endanger his life. In 408 he refused to pay the enormous sum Alaric demanded and banned pagan cults, and then, under the manipulation of Olympius, had Stilicho purged. Alaric's brother Ataulf took over the host after his death, marched west, entered Gaul in 415 and crossed the Pyrenees into Spain in 416. On the Roman side the commanders included Allobaud and Bassa, who led the cavalry in the two engagements at the Milvian Bridge and Porta Portese, and Anicius Probinus, the urban prefect who surrendered the city to Alaric in 410; the writings of Jerome and of Orosius remain the two principal documents through which the events of 410 can be judged.
kits:
卡面這把羅馬短劍是帝國步兵的制式佩劍：總長約六十公分，劍身扁平、帶血槽，重心靠前，設計重在刺而不是砍。軍人左手持大盾（scutum），右手持短劍並攜帶二至三支投槍，進攻時先用投槍覆蓋敵陣，再以盾牆前推，最後十幾步內靠整齊的刺擊把對方陣線壓垮。卡面銘文所說的「靠盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏」，正是這件兵器的用法說明。到了四世紀末，線列部隊逐漸改用更長的長劍（spatha），但短劍仍在後備部隊、民兵與傭兵手中延續，也出現在五世紀初羅馬守軍與外來傭兵同西哥德人面對面的現場。

西哥德人自備的是日耳曼式裝備：長劍、匕首（seax）、矛（framea）、可以擲出的短矛（gesa）、圓盾或橢圓形木盾，以及複合弓；頭盔在五世紀的墓葬中多見鐵片與皮條拼合的頭盔與脊飾盔。攻城方面，亞拉里克沒有希臘式的攻城塔，仍然靠火攻、破門與夜襲，410年進攻羅馬時用的是密集隊形與襲擊，而非器械戰。

羅馬方面的守城與攻城器材則是傳統：弩砲與配重投石機守牆，木製攻城塔、撞槌與攻城梯進逼城門。糧道方面靠的是北非與西西里運來的軍糧船隊，410年正是這條船隊被切斷，使守城軍在糧盡的情況下屈服。
kitsEn:
The gladius on this card was the standard sidearm of imperial infantry: about sixty centimetres overall, with a flat, grooved blade and the balance forward, designed for the thrust rather than the cut. A soldier held the large curved shield (scutum) in the left hand and the short sword in the right, carrying two or three javelins as well. On the attack the javelins were thrown to soften the enemy line, the shield wall advanced, and in the last dozen or so metres a disciplined series of thrusts broke the opposing formation. The card's own remark, that close quarters are fought with the edge of the shield and the rhythm of the thrust, is in effect the manual for this weapon. By the end of the fourth century the line infantry were moving to the longer spatha, but the gladius continued in the hands of reserves, of militia and of federate auxiliaries, and it was the sword that Roman soldiers and barbarian auxiliaries carried when they closed with the Visigoths face to face in the early fifth century.

The Visigoths brought their own Germanic equipment: the long sword, the seax, the spear (framea), the throwing gesa, round or oval wooden shields, and the composite bow. Helmets in fifth-century burials are mostly of the spangenhelm type, bands of iron or plate riveted over a leather cap, or crest-bearing helmets of the Roman tradition. For siege work Alaric had no Hellenistic siege towers: he relied on fire, on breaking doors and on night attacks, and the assault on Rome in 410 was made with massed formations and shock, not with artillery.

On the Roman side the artillery and siege equipment was the traditional repertoire: ballistae and counterweight onagers for the defence of the walls, wooden towers, battering rams and scaling ladders against the gates. Supply rested on the grain fleets from North Africa and Sicily, and it was precisely the cutting of that flow of grain in 410 that left the defenders of the city short of food and willing to negotiate.
tactics:
西哥德人擅長的是機動作戰而不是會戰：渡多瑙河後沿山區與海岸線快速推進，避免與羅馬野戰軍正面對決。396年斯提利科在塞薩利不去硬碰，而是用騎兵反覆襲擾並燒毀田地，迫使亞拉里克放棄伯羅奔尼撒；亞拉里克轉而南取科林斯，又被斯提利科在科林斯地峽以艦隊與封鎖線擋住，被迫退回北方。這一來一回定了西哥德人此後的作戰風格：流動、掠奪、避免攻堅。

406年拉達蓋蘇斯率大軍由卡爾特與東哥德人合流進入義大利，斯提利科沒有拖延，而是在維羅納附近以會戰迎擊：羅馬騎兵在正面糾纏之中由兩翼包抄，擊潰敵軍，隨後追擊至法萊里奧與里米尼，最後斬首拉達蓋蘇斯。這是西羅馬帝國在義大利本土對蠻族大軍少數的明確會戰勝利，也讓亞拉里克看清正面對抗的後果。

408至410年，亞拉里克改採封鎖戰術：切斷羅馬的糧道、控制城郊道路，再以飢餓迫和。410年8月6日米爾維恩橋之戰，羅馬騎兵擊退西哥德前鋒；同日波爾塔波爾泰塞一役雙方再戰，羅馬又佔上風，但守方已無力再戰。8月24日羅馬議會屈服，27日西哥德人入城，隨後三日縱兵掠奪，縱火焚燒聖彼得大殿，9月初大軍帶著擄獲撤往義大利南部。
tacticsEn:
What the Visigoths were good at was manoeuvre, not set-piece battle. After crossing the Danube they pushed forward along mountain routes and the coast in order to avoid meeting the Roman field army head on. In 396 Stilicho refused a general engagement in Thessaly, instead harassing with cavalry and burning the crops until Alaric gave up the Peloponnese; Alaric turned south towards Corinth and was stopped again, this time by Stilicho's fleet and blockade at the Isthmus, and forced back north. That exchange set the pattern of everything that followed: movement, plunder, and a refusal to be pinned down in a siege.

In 406 Radagaisus entered Italy with a host joined by the Taifals and the Ostrogoths. Stilicho did not delay but met him in battle near Verona: the Roman cavalry closed on the front while other units swung round the flanks, the barbarian army broke, and the pursuit ran on to Falerii and Rimini, where Radagaisus was beheaded. It was one of the few clear Roman field victories over a barbarian mass on Italian soil, and Alaric learned what a frontal fight cost.

From 408 to 410 Alaric switched to blockade: cutting the grain routes to Rome, holding the roads around the city, and using hunger to force terms. On 6 August 410 the Roman cavalry drove back the Visigothic vanguard at the Milvian Bridge; the same day the two sides fought again at Porta Portese and the Romans again had the better of it, but the defenders were in no state to keep fighting. On 24 August the Roman senate capitulated, on the 27th the Visigoths entered the city, and for three days they plundered and burned, setting fire to the basilica of St Peter, before withdrawing in early September with their captives towards southern Italy.
data:
兵力數字只能從互相矛盾的史料中取大概。克勞狄安為拉達蓋蘇斯軍隊寫的戰歌給出二十萬人這個數字，另有記錄說接近四十萬；斯提利科一方常被引用的說法是三萬名帝國軍人加上數量相近的傭兵。西哥德全軍的總數在410年前大概在數萬量級，另有為數眾多的被征服部眾隨軍同行，羅馬方面則要靠傭兵、徵召與城市民兵填補。

金額方面，408年亞拉里克向西部朝廷索價五千磅金子，羅馬磅約合三百二十七克，合計逾一點五噸黃金；羅馬議會以變賣金器與捐獻湊數，交款拖延，成為再圍城的導火線。410年西哥德人把擄獲運往沿海市集，據茲奧西莫斯記載，奴隸的標價是每人五狄納里斯，數量則沒有留下可信統計。

距離與時間方面，從拉文納到羅馬約三百五十公里，步行部隊約需三週；從多瑙河到雅典橫跨一千公里以上；西哥德人410年秋南下、412年入高盧、415至416年越比利牛斯山入西班牙，整條戰線縱深接近兩千公里。戰役的具體人數損失同樣缺少可靠記錄，唯一有數字的是410年8月6日第二場交鋒：茲奧西莫斯記羅馬方面陣亡七百至一千人，西哥德方面約三千人。
dataEn:
Figures for the armies in the field can only be taken in rough form from sources that contradict one another. The poem Claudian wrote for Radagaisus's host gives the figure of two hundred thousand, while other accounts put it nearer four hundred thousand; the side usually quoted for Stilicho is thirty thousand imperial soldiers together with a comparable number of federates. The total strength of the Visigothic host before 410 was probably in the tens of thousands, with a great many subject communities travelling with it, and the Romans filled their ranks with mercenaries, levies and the militia of the cities.

On money, in 408 Alaric demanded five thousand pounds of gold from the western court; the Roman pound was about 327 grams, so the sum was more than one and a half tonnes of gold. The senate met it by melting down plate and soliciting donations, and the delay in payment became the trigger for a second blockade. In 410 the Visigoths carried their captives down to the coastal markets, where, according to Zosimus, they were offered at five denarii a head; no reliable count of the number of them survives.

As for distance and time, the march from Ravenna to Rome is some three hundred and fifty kilometres, about three weeks for troops on foot; the crossing from the Danube to Athens runs to more than a thousand kilometres; and the whole axis of the war, from the march south in 410 through the entry into Gaul in 412 to the crossing of the Pyrenees in 415 and 416, is close to two thousand kilometres deep. Reliable casualty figures for the campaign are equally scarce. The only one that survives with numbers attached is the second engagement of 6 August 410: Zosimus records seven hundred to a thousand men lost on the Roman side and about three thousand on the Visigothic side.
cause:
直接導火線是395年1月狄奧多西一世在米蘭病逝，帝國分給兩個兒子：阿卡狄奧斯守東方，荷瑞留斯守西方。西哥德人此時是帝國的名義附庸，按382年以來的協議駐紮在巴爾干並領取軍餉，亞拉里克則希望在帝國體制之內取得更高的職位與穩定的土地。396至401年間，他屢次以越境討伐的名義率兵進入希臘、巴爾干與義大利，實際上是在向帝國勒索金錢與地盤。

帝國方面的失誤同樣關鍵。斯提利科在395年同意西哥德人渡多瑙河，是想用他們去攻擊東方的敵人，這個利用一旦失控就難以收回；401年亞拉里克拒絕被派往東方平叛，等於公開挑戰攝政的權威。405年協議之後亞拉里克退入巴爾干，此時北方局勢又變，匈奴在東哥德人烏爾迪斯與匈人首領的推動下越過多瑙河，摧毀了羅馬在多瑙河的艦隊，災難性的移民潮把更多日耳曼部落推上多瑙河，使西哥德人既失去退路又面對羅馬的重新談判。

408年成了攤牌點：亞拉里克要求西部朝廷支付巨額金錢並讓他的兒子擔任要職，朝廷先是拖延，接著由奧利匹烏斯主導的宮廷拒絕付款，並在皇帝同意下禁止異教；斯提利科被清洗致死，羅馬城失去最可靠的防衛者，亞拉里克隨後掌握西部軍權與糧道，戰爭就這樣由進攻變成接管。
causeEn:
The immediate trigger was the death of Theodosius I at Milan in January 395, after which the empire was divided between his two sons: Arcadius in the east and Honorius in the west. The Visigoths were at that time nominal subjects of the empire, settled in the Balkans under the arrangements of 382 and drawing army pay, while Alaric wanted a higher office within the Roman order and a permanent grant of land. Between 396 and 401 he repeatedly led his people into Greece, the Balkans and Italy under the pretext of pursuing enemies beyond the frontier, in practice extorting money and territory from the empire.

The mistakes on the Roman side mattered just as much. Stilicho had agreed in 395 to let the Visigoths across the Danube because he meant to use them against enemies in the east, and such a device could not be recalled once it got out of hand. In 401 Alaric refused to be sent east to put down the usurper, which was an open challenge to the regency's authority. After the settlement of 405 he withdrew into the Balkans, and the situation in the north then changed: under Hunnic pressure the Ostrogoths and their king crossed the Danube, destroyed the Roman fleet on the river, and the resulting migration pushed further Germanic groups onto the frontier, so that the Visigoths lost their line of retreat and faced Rome again on worse terms.

The year 408 became the point of open reckoning. Alaric demanded a large payment from the western court and high office for his son; the court stalled, then under the leadership of Olympius refused to pay, and with the emperor's agreement banned pagan worship. Stilicho was purged and put to death, Rome lost its most dependable defender, and Alaric, who now held the western army and the grain routes, turned a war of invasion into one of takeover.
impact:
410年8月消息傳到全歐，教父耶柔米寫信給友人帕拉，奧羅修斯則把這件事寫進《反異教史》，基督教世界在震驚之餘不得不重新思考羅馬城的地位。首都陷落本身不是羅馬帝國的終點，西部帝國還維持了近七十年，但它製造了兩個再也回不去的先例：蠻族軍隊可以攻下並掠奪羅馬，而皇帝無法用兵去阻止。

制度上的改變更為深遠。西部野戰軍越來越依賴以協議編入的部族軍，帝國在蠻化的同時把指揮權集中到少數野戰軍總監手中，這些職位後來演變成由蠻族出身的國王所握有的軍事統率權；羅馬城不再是皇帝的駐地，拉文納成為真正的政治中心，羅馬的城防與元老院在往後數十年裡逐漸失去實力。

更長期的後果在西哥德人身上。410年之後他們進入高盧，416年在君士坦提烏斯三世的協議下成為帝國在高盧的合法盟邦，之後越過比利牛斯山在西班牙建立王國，保留了羅馬的稅制、行政與土地制度，並在很短的時間裡把當地原有的西哥德人收進自己的王國。基督教也在這個過程中進入西哥德王庭：亞拉里克本人是基督徒，阿塔烏夫迎娶皇女加拉·普拉西迪婭，雙方的融合成為後來西歐諸國王權與教會結構的先聲。
impactEn:
The news of August 410 spread across Europe, and the church father Jerome wrote to his friend Palla about it while Orosius entered the event in the History against the Pagans; the Christian world, shaken, had to rethink the standing of the city of Rome. The fall of the capital was not in itself the end of the Roman empire, which survived in the west for nearly another seventy years, but it created two precedents that could never be undone: that a barbarian army could take and plunder Rome, and that an emperor could not stop it with soldiers.

The institutional change was even deeper. The western field army came to depend more and more on tribes enrolled by treaty, and as the empire barbarised it concentrated command in a handful of magistri militum, offices that were later to become the military supremacy held by barbarian kings. Rome ceased to be the emperor's residence, Ravenna became the true political centre, and the defences and the senate of Rome lost substance over the following decades.

The longer consequences fell on the Visigoths themselves. After 410 they entered Gaul, in 416 became legal federates of the empire there under the settlement with Constantius III, and then crossed the Pyrenees to found a kingdom in Spain that kept the Roman tax system, administration and land arrangements, absorbing the earlier Visigothic communities in the region into its own polity within a very short time. Christianity entered the Visigothic court through the same process: Alaric himself was a Christian, and Ataulf married the imperial princess Galla Placidia, a fusion that became the precedent for the royal and ecclesiastical structures of later western Europe.
result:
直接結果是羅馬的陷落與掠奪。410年8月27日西哥德人進入羅馬城，掠奪延續三日，城內大量建築被焚毀，聖彼得大殿與城外的葡萄園同時起火；被擄走的人被運到海岸市集降價販賣。皇帝本人仍在拉文納，帝國的機構、稅制與軍制沒有崩潰，西部帝國繼續運作，此後還能以羅馬的名義向高盧與北非調兵。

亞拉里克在410年10月於義大利南部康塞坦尼亞病逝，葬身布森托河床，屍體由行軍坑道封入河中，這是羅馬世界唯一一位被安葬在自訂墳墓裡的蠻族君主。接手部眾的弟弟阿塔烏夫沒有停留：412年率軍進入高盧，415至416年在巴倫西亞與羅馬使節達成協議，越過比利牛斯山進入西班牙，開啟西哥德王國長達三百年的統治。

就軍事層面看，亞拉里克沒有攻下一座要塞，他拿下的是首都本身，一座糧道被切斷、守軍飢餓而潰於談判的城市。這種以封斷補給代替正面攻城的做法，後來被古典作家譽為足以改寫戰爭規則的樣本，也讓西哥德人在395至410的十五年裡，從帝國的附庸變成決定西方政治格局的勢力。
resultEn:
The immediate result was the fall and sack of Rome. On 27 August 410 the Visigoths entered the city, the plunder lasted three days, a great part of the buildings was burned, and the basilica of St Peter and the vineyards outside the walls were set alight; the captives were carried away to the coastal markets and sold. The emperor himself was still in Ravenna, the administrative machine, the tax system and the army structure did not collapse, and the western empire carried on functioning, still drawing on Gaul and North Africa in the name of Rome.

Alaric died of fever at Consentia in southern Italy in October 410 and was buried in the bed of the Busento river, his body sealed into a trench dug by the marching column; he is the only barbarian ruler in the Roman world to be laid in a tomb of his own choosing. His brother Ataulf, who took over the host, did not linger: in 412 he led the people into Gaul, in 415 and 416 he reached an agreement with Roman envoys at Barcelona, and in 416 he crossed the Pyrenees into Spain, opening the three hundred year rule of the Visigothic kingdom.

In military terms Alaric took no fortress; what he took was the capital itself, a city whose grain routes were cut and whose garrison, hungry, gave way at the negotiating table. Cutting supply instead of forcing a breach became the classic example of how a war could be turned on its logistics, and it carried the Visigoths from the position of a subject of the empire in 395 to that of a power shaping the politics of the west by 410.
